slots.name: Parliament seats
slots.sentence: The far-right, anti-immigrant Vox party, which holds just 32 seats in the country’s 350-member parliament, is poised to gain.

slots.name: Regional agreements
slots.sentence: It has already entered into governing agreements with the center-right Popular Party, parliament’s second biggest faction, in four regional elections.
